errors.INVALID_CREDENTIALS: The email or password is incorrect.

errors.NETWORK: Can't reach the Mawjood server. Check your connection, then try again.

errors.SLOT_TAKEN: This time was just booked by someone else. Choose another time.

errors.SCHEDULE_OVERLAP: This block overlaps another block on the same day.
